summary: Platform & DevSecOps engineer who designs and runs Kubernetes/OpenShift at scale on sovereign infrastructure. I provision clusters fully as code, operate a large GitOps platform on ArgoCD, and bake supply-chain security into CI/CD — backed by years of full-stack delivery and engineering leadership.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Design and operate multi-cluster OpenShift on Oracle Private Cloud Appliances and bare-metal, provisioned fully as code with Terraform/OpenTofu.
Run a large GitOps platform on self-managing ArgoCD, with Helm-packaged workloads across the estate.
Own end-to-end observability, secrets (Vault), identity (Keycloak) and network policy (Cilium) on sovereign infrastructure.
Bake supply-chain security and policy gates into GitLab CI/CD.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Helped lead development of a help-desk SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies — feature work, architecture and the DevOps underneath.
Operated the AWS/Terraform infrastructure and scaling behind it: caching (Redis), search (ElasticSearch), messaging.
On the leadership team for two years — mentoring engineers and running hiring.

experience.name: Medical Navigator
bullets: Deployed a multilingual healthcare directory to AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB, via a multi-account Terraform setup driven by GitHub Actions.

experience.name: DXC Technology
bullets: Built and shipped an internal race-organisation web app end to end on a two-person team — build through deployment (Docker, Azure).
